item.title: Portland residents near ICE building win court order limiting agents’ tear gas use
item.description: Affordable housing residents near a federal immigration building in Portland, Oregon, have won a court order limiting federal officers’ use of tear gas during protests at the facility. U.S. District Judge Amy Baggio issued the preliminary injunction Friday.
